---
# Copy to courses/<slug>/week-WW/seminar-NN.qmd (NN = seminar number; WW = the
# syllabus week of its unit). Digital Skills practice sessions: practice-NN.qmd
# with `practice: N` instead of `seminar: N`.
# A SEMINAR HAS NO NEW IDEAS (AUTHORING.md, "What a seminar looks like"): the
# students apply the lectures they already had, through activities. What it
# practises and whether it is core or flexible come from schedule.yml
# (`practises:`, `core:`); the banner shows them.
# The interactive page: Recall, then each activity with its "Check your
# result" and ONE Try it (every question with a "Why:"), the Game challenge
# and a Wrap-up. No glossary: reuse the words of the lectures.
#   60 min: 3–4 activities, 10–20 questions.  90 min: 4–6 activities, 15–30 questions.
title: "The syllabus seminar title"
description: "Seminar · One short line: what students do today."
seminar: 1
ilos: [A1]
format: lesson-html
---

No new ideas today: you apply what you learned in the lectures. Do each
activity alone, then open "Check your result". Every question on this page
has its answer: try first, then check.

## Recall

- One key idea from the lectures this seminar practises, in one sentence.
- A second key idea.
- A third key idea (3–5 in all).

::: {.callout-tip title="Try it 1 · Recall"}
Choose the right answer.

::: {.match extra="wrong answer"}
A recall question on the first idea.
:   its answer

    Why: one sentence, in the words of the lecture.

A recall question on a second idea.
:   its answer

    Why: one sentence.
:::
:::

## Activity 1 · Short title

The game (or workplace) situation, in two or three short sentences, with
fixed numbers.

![Caption.](images/name.png){width=80%}

::: {.callout-note title="Activity 1 · Short title · 10 min"}
1. A numbered step for each student alone.
2. A second step.

*Your product:* a filled table, a sketch, a short decision with a reason, a file.

::: {.check}
The result, and one line of why. (A personal product: "A good answer looks
like …", then a 2–3 point self-check list.)
:::
:::

::: {.callout-tip title="Try it 2 · Short title"}
One instruction.

::: {.match extra="wrong answer"}
A question that uses the activity.
:   its answer

    Why: one sentence.
:::
:::
